parameters.content:
## 📘 WORKFLOW DETAILS

AV Rental Kit Readiness Router

For Live event AV rental. Checks shared stock depletion and explicitly approved compatible substitutes before routing dispatch-ready, substitution, cross-hire or blocked kits.

1. Accept a reservation ID and wait for stock updates.
2. Load reservation and free stock.
3. Allocate exact SKUs and approved substitutes without double-counting stock.
4. Use technician notes to catch unresolved constraints.
5. Route the assessment to one of four different operational outputs.

Node summary
Receive Reservation Change → Receive an authenticated Airtable reservation-change event.
Normalise Kit Event → Normalise input and centralise buyer configuration.
Settle Stock Reservation Updates → Allow upstream records to settle before rereading.
Fetch Rental Reservation → Retrieve the current kit lines and dispatch deadline.
Fetch Kit Stock → Read free quantities and approved compatibility groups.
Shape Kit Readiness → Allocate exact SKUs first, deplete substitutes and compute one policy route.
Check Kit Input Integrity → Reject malformed stock, duplicated SKUs or missing dispatch times.
Supply Kit Classification Model → Provide a low-temperature OpenAI model to the attached AI node.
Classify Technician Constraints → Route unresolved technician constraints to a manual task.
Route Kit Policy → Choose readiness filing, substitution review, cross-hire draft or a blocked task.
File Readiness Assessment → Update the existing reservation with a readiness assessment.
Queue Substitution Review → Append the proposed kit substitutions for an operator to review.
Draft Cross Hire Brief → Save an internal review email as a Gmail draft.
Create Blocked Kit Task → Create an internal task for urgent shortages or uncertain technician notes.
Verify Kit Artifact → Check the selected destination acknowledged the assessment.
Stop Invalid Kit Input → Expose source data problems as an execution failure.

Input: Reservations: JobName, DispatchAt (ISO timestamp), RequirementsJson array of {sku,qty,compatibilityGroup,approvedSubstitutes}, TechnicianNotes. KitStock: Sku, FreeQty integer, CompatibilityGroup. Event body: {recordId,eventId}.
Output: A reservation assessment, substitution-review row, internal cross-hire draft or blocked-kit Trello card.

Colour indices: trigger 1; transform 2; AI 3; branch 4; storage 5; notify 6.

## ⚙️ SETUP GUIDE

Configuration required before execution. Estimated setup: 45–90 minutes with prepared source tables.

Credentials by node
Receive Reservation Change: Reservation webhook — configure shared header
Fetch Rental Reservation: Airtable PAT — configure Authorization Bearer
Fetch Kit Stock: Airtable PAT — configure Authorization Bearer
Supply Kit Classification Model: n8n free OpenAI API credits
File Readiness Assessment: Airtable PAT — configure Authorization Bearer
Queue Substitution Review: Google Sheets account
Draft Cross Hire Brief: Gmail account
Create Blocked Kit Task: Trello — select connected account

1. Import JSON into your intended n8n project.
2. Select credentials by name in every integration node. No credential IDs or secrets are supplied.
3. Create the source tables and replace configuration below.
Normalise Kit Event: recordId, eventId, baseId, reservationsTable, stockTable, sheetId, trelloList, recipient, crossHireLeadHours
4. Create Reservations and KitStock with the documented fields. Add text fields ReadinessAssessment, AssessmentJson and AssessmentEventId. Create Substitutions sheet A:D. Ensure eventId is stable per change. Select webhook Header Auth. Test all four routes and unclear technician notes.
5. Run the supplied synthetic cases with test credentials and check the output artifacts. Verify failed API calls, empty collections and duplicate execution behaviour.
6. Keep unpublished until integration tests pass.

## 🎨 CUSTOMISATION

1. Edit Normalise Kit Event to change the 12-hour cross-hire lead time.
2. Edit Shape Kit Readiness to add verified connector-family checks.
3. Edit Classify Technician Constraints to include your venue restrictions.
4. Replace Create Blocked Kit Task with your dispatch ticket system.

## ℹ️ ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

External actions use continueRegularOutput with maxTries=3 and waitBetweenTries=2000. Data guards reject malformed responses; see branch notes for AI fallback behaviour. Retrying a non-idempotent draft or notification after a network timeout can duplicate it.

OpenAI usage is billed by your account; actual cost depends on model, input size and retries. Review provider quotas. Airtable reads are capped at 100 records and fail closed when an offset is returned; add pagination before larger deployments.

Only operational fields are sent to AI. Avoid customer personal data in free text. Execution history may contain source rows and draft text; set retention and restrict credentials to the intended tables/folders.

Assessments are proposals, not authoritative reservations. The source system must own stock locking and dispatch. Concurrent jobs can compete for the same observed free stock. Repeated events may duplicate Sheets rows, drafts or cards: deduplicate by eventId at the sender and reconcile ambiguous retries. At most 100 stock SKUs and 50 kit lines per run.

Local structure and algorithm tests are provided. Connected execution remains pending until buyer-specific tables and credentials are configured. The signed-in workspace was checked for today’s duplicate batch. Historical memory file was unavailable. Search results cannot establish absolute originality.

Creator: Swapnil AI Labs — swapnil.mandloi7@gmail.com — swapnilailabs.netlify.app

**Receive Reservation Change**
Receive an authenticated Airtable reservation-change event.
POST body: recordId and eventId; select Header Auth credential.

**Normalise Kit Event**
Normalise input and centralise buyer configuration.
Replace REPLACE values; inputs use explicit defaults.

**Settle Stock Reservation Updates**
Allow upstream records to settle before rereading.
Wait 15 seconds; no backward connection.

**Fetch Rental Reservation**
Retrieve the current kit lines and dispatch deadline.
RequirementsJson and DispatchAt must be current at source.

**Fetch Kit Stock**
Read free quantities and approved compatibility groups.
FreeQty must already exclude reservations for other jobs.

**Shape Kit Readiness**
Allocate exact SKUs first, deplete substitutes and compute one policy route.
Only approvedSubstitutes with matching CompatibilityGroup qualify.

**Check Kit Input Integrity**
Reject malformed stock, duplicated SKUs or missing dispatch times.
False output stops before drafting any action.

**Supply Kit Classification Model**
Provide a low-temperature OpenAI model to the attached AI node.
Choose an available model; temperature 0.

**Classify Technician Constraints**
Route unresolved technician constraints to a manual task.
Clear reaches deterministic policy routing; review/other goes to Trello.

**Route Kit Policy**
Choose readiness filing, substitution review, cross-hire draft or a blocked task.
Routes derive from stock maths; AI cannot alter quantities.

**File Readiness Assessment**
Update the existing reservation with a readiness assessment.
Does not reserve inventory or authorise dispatch.

**Queue Substitution Review**
Append the proposed kit substitutions for an operator to review.
Columns: eventId, recordId, status, assessmentJson.

**Draft Cross Hire Brief**
Save an internal review email as a Gmail draft.
Draft only; recipient, subject and body come from Shape.

**Create Blocked Kit Task**
Create an internal task for urgent shortages or uncertain technician notes.
Configured Trello list; human resolves readiness.

**Verify Kit Artifact**
Check the selected destination acknowledged the assessment.
Require a saved record/card/draft ID or one appended row.

**Stop Invalid Kit Input**
Expose source data problems as an execution failure.
No automatic inventory reservation or dispatch takes place.
